PLAYER GUIDE
GUIDE 03 / SURVIVAL

Your first survival day,
from berries to a home.

What the four bars mean, what to do in the first minutes, which crafting chain gets you tools and a roof, and what can actually hurt you.

Voxelgame main dd29d91 · 8 min read · New players · feature ledger · all guides

01 / 09

Switch to survival

New worlds begin in creative. Press F4 to switch; you keep your pack, hotbar and position, and the four bars appear lower left. Every new world's pack holds 12 Berries, 2 Water flasks, 1 Empty flask and 4 Alder board pieces, and switching modes or respawning never grants more. New worlds: creative by default, survival starter supplies

Tip. Items you took from the creative catalog before switching stay in your pack, so start in a fresh world if you want a true first day.
02 / 09

The four bars

Key or actionWhat it does
HPHealth. It regenerates slowly while both hunger and thirst stay above 65.
HUNGERA full bar lasts about 40 minutes.
THIRSTA full bar lasts about 30 minutes.
STAMINASpent by sprinting, which needs more than 3% left. Resting at home refills it.

The bars do not change in creative. The starter pack is good for roughly 24 minutes of food and 21 minutes of water, which the Home tab's trip readout will tell you. Health, hunger, thirst and stamina Home tab trip-planning readout

03 / 09

Drink and eat

Key or actionWhat it does
T next to waterDrink (+22 thirst) and refill every Empty flask you carry.
T away from waterDrink one carried Water flask (+35 thirst); you keep the Empty flask.
REat one food: Berries first, then Venison, Raw meat, and Cooked meat last.
Click a food or flask in the PackUse that exact item instead.

Only four foods exist. Berries come only from the starter pack, so the renewable food is hunting, best cooked over charcoal (below). Fruit blocks and Date clusters are building blocks, not food. Eating (R) Drinking and water flasks (T)

04 / 09

Mine and gather

Hold left click on a block within 6 m. A progress bar fills and the whole one-metre block, up to eight pieces, goes straight into your pack. Hold Shift to take a single half-metre piece. Nothing drops on the ground: if the pieces do not fit, the block stays where it is and the status line says 'Capacity full; block left behind'. Mining and collecting blocks

Your pack is limited by weight, 80 kg, not by slots. Carry capacity (mass-based pack) Any block can be mined by hand; a tool only speeds up its own material: the pickaxe about 4× on rock, glass and masonry, the hatchet about 3.6× on logs, boards and leaves, the shovel about 3.4× on loose ground. Mining speed and tool effectiveness

Good to know. Water and other liquids cannot be collected.
05 / 09

Make your first tools

  1. Mine a log piece from a tree and open the inventory with E, then the Craft tab.
  2. Choose one of the 'Split … boards' recipes: one log piece makes four board pieces.
  3. Mine stone blocks; any of the 26 natural stones counts.
  4. Craft a Stone hatchet, Stone pickaxe or Stone shovel, then the sword if you want to hunt. Crafting a tool equips it automatically.
Tools & arms 4 recipes
RecipeMakesNeeds
Stone sword1× Stone sword
  • 4× Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)
  • 2× Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)

Crafted tools are equipped automatically.

Stone pickaxe1× Stone pickaxe
  • 6× Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)
  • 4× Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)
Stone hatchet1× Stone hatchet
  • 4× Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)
  • 4× Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)

The 4 starter boards plus 4 pieces of any natural stone (e.g. shore gravel dug by hand) make the first hatchet.

Stone shovel1× Stone shovel
  • 2× Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)
  • 4× Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)

There is a single tool tier, and tools never wear out. There is no workbench: everything is crafted from the Craft tab. Stone tools (single tier, no durability)

Careful. Do not press X to quick-craft with the starter kit. It crafts the first affordable recipe in list order, so with only boards in your pack it burns your four boards into two Charcoal. Quick craft (X)
06 / 09

Hunt, cook and fill flasks

Animals never attack you. Left click one to hit it: a bare hand or ordinary tool deals 12 damage and the Stone sword deals 28. In survival what it drops goes straight into your pack; drops that do not fit are lost. Hitting animals (melee) Animal drops

Fire & food 4 recipes
RecipeMakesNeeds
Burn a charcoal pile2× Charcoal
  • 4× Boards of any species (Alder, Birch or Pine boards; mixable)
Cook raw meat1× Cooked meat
  • 1× Raw meat
  • 1× Charcoal

Raw meat restores 8 hunger, Cooked meat 30.

Roast venison2× Cooked meat
  • 1× Venison
  • 1× Charcoal

One Venison (18 hunger raw) becomes 2 Cooked meat (30 each).

Blow glass flasks2× Empty flask
  • 8× Glass
  • 1× Charcoal

8 Glass pieces = one full glass block. Fill flasks by pressing T near drinkable water.

Materials 1 recipes
RecipeMakesNeeds
Fire glass16× Glass
  • 24× Pale sand
  • 1× Charcoal

3 blocks of Pale sand make 2 blocks of Glass. Only Pale sand works (not Sea, Fine dune, Red, Black or Shell sand). Besides this recipe, the Survey workshop landmark's one-time find gives 8 Glass.

Fire work is crafting, not a placed furnace or campfire: it works anywhere. Raw meat restores 8 hunger and Cooked meat 30, and one Venison roasts into two Cooked meat. Charcoal, cooking and glass (no furnace)

07 / 09

Build a home and rest

  1. Stand on dry, solid ground, open the Home tab and choose Establish home. It costs 8 board pieces and places a small crate 1.5 m beside you.
  2. Move items to and from the crate by clicking rows in the Home tab; it holds up to 400 kg while you are within 6 m. Shift + click moves as many as fit.
  3. Build a roof with cover on at least two sides next to the crate, then choose Rest / set respawn there.

Resting sets your respawn point and refills stamina; it does not heal or feed you. Leaves and tree trunks count as cover, plants and water do not. Home crate: establish, storage, repair, pack up Resting and setting your respawn point

08 / 09

What can hurt you

  • Falls: up to 3 m is free, each extra metre costs 5 HP, so about 23 m is fatal from full health. Only landing on solid ground counts. Fall damage and other dangers
  • Starvation and thirst when the bars run empty.
  • Extreme cold only at very high altitude, and explosions. No drowning, lava, fire or hostile animals exist in this version.
  • Death respawns you at once at your rest point (the world's start until you rest at home) and you lose nothing. Death and respawn
Good to know. Body temperature is never shown and, with this version's numbers, heat damage cannot happen. Body temperature and shelter
09 / 09

Not in the game yet

Planned, not in the game. Planting and growing food, a placeable furnace with smelting and metal tools, visible items on the ground, a larger pack and achievements are planned but absent from this version. They are tracked in the feature ledger and will get their own guide only after they ship.

How this guide was checked

Meter timings, damage values, recipe counts and key behaviours come from the game source at the audited commit and its own unit tests, each traced to a ledger entry.
